The '''Republic Consulate''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] embassy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jandoon]] that was torn down during the [[Cold War]]. During the demolition, crews found a secret annex that was significantly booby-trapped.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Construction Site}}</ref>
